notes.title: Deathblossom - Achievements!
notes.notes:
This small update makes a couple minor tweaks and adds Steam achievements! Changes:
[list]
[*]     Steam achievements implemented
[*]     Alt+Enter for fullscreen toggle
[*]     A new cinematic that ends Cotton's chase sequence
[*]     Cursor updated & buttons highlight properly
[*]     A link on the main menu to find me other places
[*]     Yarrow's phase 1 vines are slower & ammo boxes are more conveniently placed
[*]     Godot version changed to 4.3
[/list]
Thanks for enjoying the game!

- Zoquete

notes.title: Deathblossom - Update & Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello!

Thanks to the community's feedback, I've been able to put together a small quality of life patch to improve the game and address various issues. Noteworthy updates:
[list]
[*]     Kick timing & hitbox is more generous
[*]     Stonecrop's attacks are better telegraphed and her fight is generally easier
[*]     Control rebinding options are more obvious
[*]     Windows application icon fixed
[*]     Mouse is confined to the game area during top down gameplay
[*]     Camera is no longer off-center at different window sizes
[*]     Hints for certain stages will now appear after a number of deaths (Hints can be disabled in the options menu)
[*]     Various other small tweaks and improvements
[/list]
If you were getting a black screen and disabling all antialiasing through your GPU didn't work, I have added the option to run the game in a compatibility mode which may fix the issue. You can do this by selecting the launch option "Play Deathblossom (Compatibility)".

Thank you for enjoying the game and make sure to keep an eye out for my future projects!

- Zoquete
